verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at support.claude.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the Claude Help Center. Many support articles are served as raw .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting llms.txt or the markdown docs for agent use, evidence of an llms.txt covering developer/API docs rather than only the Help Center, a working docs-root markdown endpoint (/en/.md returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
